about: Adventure mode scene inventory (session 25). Read by tools/import_story.py (the scenes with a script in tables/story/scripts are 'ported'); documented in docs/ADVENTURE.md. Fields: id (stable, port), list (index in the original's developer CutsceneList_42, RE), title (its name, RE), room (json frame = set_frame index + 1), g4 (global 4 selecting the scene inside the room), triggers (new: a new Adventure; end:I: frame 8 after stage I), next / skip / stage (the steps after the scene, its SKIP SCENE target, the NEXT STAGE target of panel 2), panel (GUIPause frame of its pause menu: 1 RESUME / SKIP SCENE / QUIT, 2 RESUME / SKIP SCENE / NEXT STAGE), chr (g1 mask: 1 Lilac, 2 Carol, 4 Milla), dialog (DialogData handle) and lines (paragraph range, inclusive; also: single paragraphs outside it), evidence (RE / RV / INFERRED per field), missing (what is not known or not available).
